elements.text:
Settings / Indicator Legend:

Each card displays the patient's photo, age & condition.
At the top-right corner of each card, an indicator dot shows status:

🟢 Green dot: Vitals normal, up to date
🟡 Yellow dot: Follow-up due (medicine/routine checkup)
🔴 Red dot: High Risk (BP > 140/90, Glucose high, or Urgent Referral)

SwasthyaMitr AI Voice Interaction:

• Zero-literacy elderly patients tap the large mic.
• They can speak in their regional dialect (Hindi, Tamil, etc.).
• AI replies with voice instructions on when & how
to take medicines.
